classification_rationale: The customer disputes a damage charge, pointing to check-out photos showing the damage pre-dated their rental, which is a charge dispute resolvable by checking the existing inspection record.

draft.reply_body:
Dear Oulujoen Betonityö Oy,

I'm sorry to hear this, and I understand the frustration given how long you've been renting with us.

Under our policy, no damage charge applies where the damage is confirmed — from the check-out photographs or our own pre-rental inspection record — to have existed before the rental began. I'll pull the check-out photographs taken when the breaker was handed over and compare them against the depot's own inspection record for that unit.

If the damage is confirmed as pre-existing, the charge will be reversed in full. I'll come back to you with the outcome as soon as this review is complete.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service

commitments.description: Review the check-out photographs against the depot's pre-rental inspection record, and reverse the damage charge in full if the damage is confirmed pre-existing
